scripts.test: pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:py
scripts.test:py:gpu: cd apps/gpu-worker && RUN_GPU_ACCEPT=1 python -m pytest -m gpu_acceptance -q
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:packages && pnpm run verify:client && pnpm run verify:gateway && pnpm run verify:worker && pnpm run verify:rust
scripts.verify:client: node scripts/provision-ffmpeg.mjs --check && cd apps/client && pnpm build
scripts.verify:gateway: cd apps/gateway && pnpm test && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.verify:rust: cd apps/client/src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
